cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): [MWI-002] answers question 1: the Act has been in force since 3 June 2024 and restricts transfers. [MWI-002] and [MWI-004] answer question 2: adequate law, binding corporate rules, contract or consent permit a transfer, and the only local storage rule held is for health data [MWI-006]. No published way is held, so the run stops at 3.
